top_signals.title: By The Way: Headlines You May Have Missed
top_signals.summary: AI in White House press releases, a 'brutal' but surprisingly popular class at Harvard, Life Magazine rises again, and the dwindling justification of day light savings: Join Nathan Hager, David Gura and Lisa Mateo for a roundup of headlines you may have missed, but gotta see. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: City of London chief named UK’s most influential black Briton
top_signals.summary: The chief executive of the City of London corporation has been named the UK’s most influential black Briton in this year’s Powerlist.
